description: Linux kernel module source code for a Button Hotplug driver, handling input events for buttons and generating uevents.

methods.name: button_hotplug_event
methods.description: Handles input events, creates button events, and updates seen timestamps.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button event work item.

methods.name: button_hotplug_connect
methods.description: Handles connection of input devices with relevant button codes.

methods.name: button_hotplug_disconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection of input device handles.

methods.name: button_hotplug_init
methods.description: Initializes the button hotplug driver, registers input handler.

methods.name: button_hotplug_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the driver, unregisters input handler.
